# Experience Strangford Lough & Lecale.

The Strangford Lough and Lecale AONB office is based in Downpatrick, covering the whole of the Strangford and Lecale Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty, taking in much of the Ards Peninsula, Strangford Lough and Lecale

[Find out about what we do](https://strangfordlough.org/projects/)

## About our Landscape and Heritage in Strangford & Lecale AONB

Welcome to the Strangford & Lecale Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty (AONB), a place where daily life is closely connected to nature, built heritage and cultural landscapes. Situated in the east of County Down, this distinctive area tells the story of a glacial past, with one of the world’s finest examples of drumlin hills and island landscapes shaping both land and sea.

Strangford Lough and the surrounding landscapes form a vital part of the **[Mourne Gullion Strangford UNESCO Global Geopark](https://mournegullionstrangfordgeopark.com/about-our-geopark/)**, a UNESCO-designated landscape that brings together mountains, lowlands, coast and marine environments across south-east Northern Ireland.

## Things to do

Strangford and Lecale offers a variety of Things To Do for visitors to enjoy the countryside. Walkers and cyclists can follow a number of routes ranging in length and difficulty all of which give users the chance to explore the geology, archaeology, wildlife and legend of the area.
